v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Iurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
text.en: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

text.la: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
text.en: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

text.la: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
text.en: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

text.la: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
text.en: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

text.la: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
text.en: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

text.la: Fratres: Iam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Iesu.
text.en: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Estóte fortes * in bello, et pugnáte cum antíquo serpénte: et accipiétis regnum ætérnum.
text.en: Be valiant * in battle, fight the ancient serpent and accept the eternal kingdom.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Matthíam Apostolórum tuórum collégio sociásti: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut, eius interventióne, tuæ circa nos pietátis semper víscera sentiámus.
text.en: O God, Who added blessed Matthias to the company of Thy Apostles; grant, we beseech Thee, that by his intercession we may ever be aware of the depth of Thy love for us.

title.la: Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima
title.en: Feria Quarta infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima

text.la: Tradétur enim géntibus ad illudéndum, et flagellándum, et crucifigéndum.
text.en: For He shall be delivered to the Gentiles, to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Deus, innocéntiæ restitútor et amátor, dírige ad te tuórum corda servórum: ut, spíritus tui fervóre concépto, et in fide inveniántur stábiles, et in ópere efficáces.
text.en: God, the Renewer and Lover of innocency, turn the hearts of all thy servants to thyself, that so they, being enkindled with the fire of thy Spirit, may be found ever rooted in faith, and fruitful in works.
